SELECT v.id, v.name, v.cover_path AS coverPath, v.city, v.address, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT st.name ORDER BY st.name SEPARATOR '、') AS sportNames, MIN(ss.price_fen) AS startingPriceFen, DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(MIN(ss.start_at), '+00:00', '+08:00'), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s+08:00') AS nextAvailableAt FROM s_venue v JOIN s_court c ON c.venue_id = v.id AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN s_court_sport cs ON cs.court_id = c.id JOIN s_sport_type st ON st.id = cs.sport_type_id AND st.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN s_session_slot ss ON ss.court_id = c.id AND ss.sport_type_id = st.id AND ss.status = 'OPEN' AND ss.start_at >= #{now} AND ss.slot_date = #{date} WHERE v.status = 'ACTIVE'
AND v.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND st.owner_venue_id IS NULL AND st.id = #{sportTypeId} GROUP BY v.id, v.name, v.cover_path, v.city, v.address ORDER BY nextAvailableAt IS NULL, nextAvailableAt, v.id

SELECT c.id, c.name, c.image_path AS imagePath, c.status, GROUP_CONCAT(st.name ORDER BY st.name SEPARATOR '、') AS sportNames, GROUP_CONCAT(st.id ORDER BY st.id SEPARATOR ',') AS sportIds FROM s_court c LEFT JOIN s_court_sport cs ON cs.court_id = c.id LEFT JOIN s_sport_type st ON st.id = cs.sport_type_id WHERE c.venue_id = #{venueId} GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.image_path, c.status ORDER BY c.id

SELECT DISTINCT st.* FROM s_sport_type st JOIN s_court_sport cs ON cs.sport_type_id = st.id JOIN s_court c ON c.id = cs.court_id WHERE c.venue_id = #{venueId} AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND st.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY st.owner_venue_id IS NOT NULL, st.id

SELECT ss.id, ss.court_id AS courtId, c.name AS courtName, ss.sport_type_id AS sportTypeId, st.name AS sportName, DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(ss.start_at, '+00:00', '+08:00'), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s+08:00') AS startAt, DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(ss.end_at, '+00:00', '+08:00'), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s+08:00') AS endAt, ss.price_fen AS priceFen FROM s_session_slot ss JOIN s_court c ON c.id = ss.court_id AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN s_sport_type st ON st.id = ss.sport_type_id AND st.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE ss.venue_id = #{venueId} AND ss.slot_date = #{date} AND ss.status = 'OPEN' AND ss.start_at >= #{earliest} AND ss.sport_type_id = #{sportTypeId} ORDER BY c.name, ss.start_at
